scope: Basic lawful existing Item<->Expense relation before any Widget; no second financial aggregate

actualFindings.finding: Reuses LedgerExpenseEntryScreen in modal, not a formal link worker
P3 addExpense passes journey/title/date/mode, no stable target Item identity; a prefill does not establish a relation
Existing strict LINK_EXPENSE/UNLINK_EXPENSE payload has expenseId,targetKind,targetId; do not invent another relation model
Both commands explicitly throw OWNING_CAPABILITY_REQUIRED; schema existence is not enabled write authority
Collection only exports links whose Expense is independently authorized and whose target is visible; default expense allowlist empty; link record contains no qualified amount summary

minimumOwningPort: Ledger/Core qualifies both same-Trip endpoints and link-management rights, stable tuple/operation/digest/CAS/receipt; no read==write inference
Existing Native entry supplies exact Item ID and return context; changing/unlinking relation does not delete or reprice Expense
Use existing authorized Ledger money/FX read for later summary; do not add sums in Core/DayFeed or infer0 from unavailable Reader
negativeCases: Readable Item + hidden private Expense cannot leak link/amount
Readable Expense + hidden target cannot leak target
Same original relation operation idempotent; changed tuple with same operation rejected
Revoke/account-switch clears qualified visibility, old result cannot repaint another Account
Unlink removes only relationship; Expense and its independent ownership remain
